hero.title: Our Sacred Story
hero.subtitle: Four Decades of Faith & Craftsmanship
hero.description: Since 1985, Sacred Crafts has been creating beautiful wooden religious art pieces that inspire faith and bring peace to homes and hearts around the world.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To create beautiful, meaningful religious art that deepens faith, inspires devotion, and brings the sacred into everyday life. Each piece we craft is a prayer made tangible, a testament to the enduring power of faith and the beauty of traditional craftsmanship.

values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: The principles that guide every aspect of our work and define who we are as artisans and people of faith.

faith.title: Faith & Devotion
faith.description: Every piece is created with prayer and blessed with love, bringing spiritual significance to your sacred space.

craftsmanship.title: Master Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.description: Our skilled artisans use traditional techniques passed down through generations to create timeless pieces.

quality.title: Quality Excellence
quality.description: We use only the finest materials and maintain the highest standards in every aspect of our work.

community.title: Community Impact
community.description: We support local artisans and contribute to charitable causes that strengthen our faith community.

journey.title: Our Journey
journey.subtitle: From humble beginnings to serving families nationwide, our story is one of faith, dedication, and growth.

1985.title: Humble Beginnings
1985.description: Founded by Master Antonio Rodriguez in his small workshop, creating pieces for the local parish.

1995.title: Growing Recognition
1995.description: Our work gained recognition throughout the region, with churches commissioning custom pieces.

2005.title: Expanding the Team
2005.description: Welcomed Sister Maria Catherine and other skilled artisans to meet growing demand.

2015.title: National Reach
2015.description: Launched our online presence, bringing sacred art to families across the country.

2024.title: Continuing Legacy
2024.description: Today, we continue to honor tradition while embracing new ways to serve the faithful.

artisans.title: Meet Our Artisans
artisans.subtitle: The skilled hands and faithful hearts behind every piece in our collection.

antonio.name: Master Antonio Rodriguez
antonio.description: Antonio has dedicated his life to creating sacred art, learning traditional techniques passed down through generations of his family.

maria.name: Sister Maria Catherine
maria.description: Sister Maria brings deep spiritual insight to our designs, ensuring each piece reflects authentic Catholic tradition and devotion.

michael.name: Michael Thompson
michael.description: Michael's expertise in wood selection and finishing ensures that every piece not only looks beautiful but will last for generations.

materials.title: Premium Materials
materials.description: We source only the finest hardwoods, carefully selected for their beauty and durability.

techniques.title: Traditional Techniques
techniques.description: Our methods honor centuries-old traditions while incorporating modern quality standards.

blessed.title: Blessed Creations
blessed.description: Every piece is blessed and created with prayer, adding spiritual significance to its beauty.

guarantee.title: Lifetime Guarantee
guarantee.description: We stand behind our work with a comprehensive guarantee on craftsmanship and materials.

cta.title: Become Part of Our Story
cta.description: When you choose Sacred Crafts, you're not just purchasing art—you're joining a community of faith, supporting traditional craftsmanship, and bringing sacred beauty into your home.
